<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 1.40.0 -->

## What's Changed
### New Features 🎉
* Adding Safari Support for st.experimental_audio_input without need of ffmpeg library by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9571
* allow static serving to follow symlink by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9147
* [feat] Add `use_container_width` to `st.image` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9547
* Change `st.text` font and overflow styles by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9572
* Expose the st.pills command again by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9612
* adding download button to audio_input by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9637
* deexperiment audio_input widget by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9654
* Feature/button group: st.segmented_control by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9418
* Allow adding the Streamlit logo in markdown by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9670
* Replace typographical symbols in markdown by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9677
* For button group commands, rename 'multiple' to 'multi' for selection_mode by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9701
* Add a delay before displaying the running man icon.  by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9732
* [feat] Localize calendar week start date in st.date_input by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9706
### Bug Fixes 🐛
* [Fix] Tooltip code block styling by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9529
* [fix] st.pydeck_chart selection fixes by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9552
* [Fix] Message box title colors by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9555
* [Fix] Tooltip visibility in `st.sidebar` & `st.dialog` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9554
* [Fix] Error on invalid `st.text_area` height by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9561
* Re-introduce "Allow array parameters in CLI" by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9577
* [Fix] `st.navigation` reconciles `client.showSidebarNavigation` config by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9589
* [Fix] Show input instructions in form when allowed and focused by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9576
* [Fix] MPA page layout by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9479
* Fix page link margin regression by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9625
* [Fix] Clear fragment autoreruns when changing pages by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9617
* Fix clear cached class method regression by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9642
* Eliminate symlink requirement in component request handler by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9588
* FIx button cursor regression by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9733
* Fix issue with local storage in Android webview by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9744
* [fix] Revamp `preferredLayouts` state for `set_page_config` and layout in User Settings by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9723
### Other Changes
* Release/1.39.0 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9575
* Upgrade deck.gl to the latest version by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9636
* Deploy dialog redesign by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9681
* Fix typo in docstring for `selection_mode` of `st.dataframe` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9699
* changing icon and label for st.audio_input by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9712
* Deploy dialog feedback by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9718
* Allow Pillow 11 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9742
* Deploy dialog feedback cont’d by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9741
* Use toolbar for fullscreen button by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9721
